input: last 20 simple close returns, oldest to newest; same input to all architectures
normalization: single mean/std over training windows only; y mean/std over eligible known training targets; population std
output: direct dollar change for separate h=1 and h=5 models; add last close
selection: mean of 3 seed-specific validation RMSEs, then mean MAE, then id; never pick best seed
refit: new model on each origin; expanding eligible training set
failure_policy: record failed fit; candidate/horizon excluded unless all origins and seeds completed
